819:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

819:t_1:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...It seems we were still underestimating the Earth race.」

819:t_1:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hold on, $$アウストラリス$$. This was just a string of coincidences.」

819:t_1:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Who would ever imagine that the $$時空震動弾$$ would warp causality, and that the warp would reach the $$黒い太陽#sol$$?」

819:t_1:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is what we call underestimating.」

819:t_1:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「They have four $$スフィア$$s over there, too. And that includes the $$いがみ合う双子$$, to boot.」

819:t_1:9.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What's more, there is a power even we don't know. And it has made contact with the $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

819:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You sure are worked up, $$バルビエル$$.」

819:t_1:13.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Look who's talking. You haven't managed to steal even a single $$スフィア$$ yourself.」

819:t_1:14.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Hurry up and take down everything except the $$ジェミニオン$$, and bring in the remaining three $$スフィア$$s.」

819:t_1:15.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You can't really blame $$バルビエル$$ for that. Even if we defeat the other Reactors, we can't take their $$スフィア$$s.」

819:t_1:18.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So it comes down to two choices: win those guys over, or beat them down thoroughly until they submit.」

819:t_1:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But that's all over now...!」

819:t_1:20.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$バルビエル$$...」

819:t_1:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I can't stand their very existence anymore.」

819:t_1:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If they die and the $$スフィア$$s get transferred to some other world, I'll chase after them...! So let me take them out!」

819:t_1:24.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Are you serious, $$アウストラリス$$?」

819:t_1:25.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That is, first of all, only if they make it back to this world.」

819:t_1:27.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Let me say the rest, Your Majesty the Emperor.」

819:t_1:28.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$$バルビエル$$... If you think you can beat them, go ahead and try.」

819:t_1:30.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Now that the fire has finally caught in the Empire too, I'll be making my move as well.」

819:t_1:31.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I can't wait, $$バルビエル$$. For the day you and my $$ジェミニオン$$ fight.」

819:t_1:32.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「When that day comes, I'll make you learn... who the favored one really is.」

819:t_1:33.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...It all depends on whether they can make it back.」

819:t_1:34.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$c... Beyond time and space, you will learn how terrifying the $$サイデリアル$$ are.」

819:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. The situation is unclear, but we will be opening the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ for business.」

819:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

819:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now then, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

820:t_000:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This space... It's the same situation as when we were thrown into the galactic center...!」

820:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「At this rate, are we going to end up in the galaxy again...!?」

820:t_000:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「This is the gap between cause and effect... the horizon called possibility.」

820:t_000:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$カヲル$$... What are you...」

820:t_000:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Our feelings, from within the warped causality, have come to touch a great power. And that will give birth to power.」

820:t_001:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「So these three were the ones chosen...」

820:t_001:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Right now, they are bound by the chains of causality, in the gap between cause and effect. All that's left is for that...」

820:t_001:5.en:
$n
「$$シンジ$$, Colonel $$シャア$$, $$クロウ$$...! At this rate...!」

820:t_001:6.en:
$n
「Go to $$シンジ$$」
「Go to $$クロウ$$」
「Go to $$シャア$$」

820:t_003:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I see... So that's how it turns out.」

820:t_006:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Stay back, $n! This situation... something is warped!」

$$高性能ＡＩ$$

825:t_10:5.en:
